content: To be in love is to be in paradise. To love without demanding anything in return is the greatest joy.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

In Osho's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life needs your unconditional support or appreciation today without any transaction?
